judge_action_log.about: changes: every control change the sidecar accepted, in order: the plant step at which it took effect (360 steps per plant hour) and its plant hour, the end of its 20-minute ramp (step + 120) in steps and hours, and the change as applied. Rejected and refused control requests appear only in request_log.json. initial_setpoints: the settings in force at plant hour 0, as plant-manual.md states them.

about: requests: every API call the SCADA sidecar received, in served order (n), whether accepted, rejected, or refused, documented route or not.

step: the plant step at which the call was served (one step is 10 plant seconds, 360 steps per plant hour); plant_hour: the same in plant hours. Plant time starts at the first call to a documented operation; earlier calls are logged at step 0.
method, path, target: as received (target is the raw request target). query: the parsed query string, last value per key. body: the parsed JSON body of a POST, or its text when it did not parse.
status: the HTTP status served (null when no response was served); error: the error message, if any; response: the JSON body served.

A telemetry response's packets and an event-log response's events are logged as {table, start, stop}: rows start to stop - 1 of telemetry_packets or event_records, keyed by their position in the stream (packets in the order the SCADA master closed them, events in log order). Each table holds every row some response served, once, and nothing else.
contract_md: CONTRACT.md's clock sentence and Annex A, verbatim as shipped to the operator.

contract_md.clock: Plant hours count from 0 at the start of the run. Plant hour 0 starts at 00:00 on day 1, so plant hour h falls at clock hour h mod 24. The contract window is plant hours 66 to 72 (18:00 to 24:00 on day 3).
